# `oaap app login-required`

every route asks for a login, the package's public ones included (RFC-0092).

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap app login-required [--reason REASON]
                               [--tenant INSTANCE_TENANT]
                               name {on,off}
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `name` | -- |
| `switch` | (one of `on`, `off`) |
| `--reason REASON` | why; goes into the tenant's log |
| `--tenant INSTANCE_TENANT` | tenant label: read the instance as a NAME inside this tenant (also: <tenant>/<name>) |
